title: Ten Plaintiffs in Estonia Reportedly Fined After AI-Assisted Court Filing Cited Nonexistent Researchers in Logging-Permit Dispute
summary: Ten plaintiffs challenging a logging permit in Estonia reportedly received fines after submitting an AI-assisted document citing researchers who did not exist and studies the court could not locate. Tallinn Administrative Court held them responsible for checking the references. The plaintiffs denied intending to mislead the court; the fines became final after appeals.
